methodology: T30a grammar-only measurement (spec 260904 SS15.9 block (1)), computed over the whole regenerated plr-sema/data/derived_contracts.json. atom_kind_counts tallies, over the non-Opaque population, how many guards' predicate trees contain >= 1 occurrence of each named atom kind -- independent per-kind tallies, not a mutually-exclusive partition (one guard can count toward several kinds). filtered_emptiness_count and chained_cmp_count are reporting-only heuristics keyed off the raw condition text to disambiguate shapes that parse identically (AnyOf from G3's len(Filtered(...)) rewrite vs. a direct all()/any() call; a chained ast.Compare vs. an ordinary `and`-joined pair) -- this disambiguation is NOT part of the predicate_ast grammar itself, which does not track provenance. Superseded by T30b's plr_sema.eval.t30_measure, which also builds the binding-coverage blocks (2)-(5) this grammar-only task does not.
